figures.title: Retained baseline generation speed
figures.alt: Thirty baseline observations and six medians. At 2k, 8k and 32k input targets, 2k-output medians are 19.23, 20.09 and 18.94 tokens per second; 8k-output medians are 25.47, 24.09 and 24.29. All six cells have five observations.
figures.caption: Each small point is one successful primary observation in the same baseline process; large diamonds are medians of five, and lines span the observed minimum to maximum. These are accepted generation tokens per second, excluding prefill, not confidence intervals.

figures.title: Long-input waiting and concurrent completion
figures.alt: The 131,072-token input waited 202.74 seconds for first output and finished in 543.40 seconds. The 516,031-token input waited 897.37 seconds and finished in 1,267.89 seconds. Four shorter requests completed at 51.84 aggregate tokens per second; near-full input plus three shorter companions completed at 49.91, including prefill.
figures.caption: Individual requests are split into time before first output and remaining request time. The other panel reports whole-batch output tokens per second including prefill and scheduling. Every request produced 8,192 tokens; each batch produced 32,768. Cases and batches ran once, with prefix reuse permitted. The mixed batch followed the individual near-full request; four fresh maximum-length histories were not tested.

figures.title: Incomplete batched-candidate comparison
figures.alt: Three complete five-observation candidate cells changed generation speed by minus 0.89, plus 1.47 and minus 0.88 percent. The next cell showed plus 3.93 percent over only four completed observations, before a request failed. Both 32k-input cells were not reached. No complete cell met the minimum plus 5 percent speed criterion.
figures.caption: Solid markers have five successful candidate observations; the hollow diamond has four and is incomplete after the next request failed. Missing cells were not reached. The +5% reference is only the minimum speed criterion, alongside within-run variation, correctness and required concurrency. No overall gain or candidate concurrency cost was measured.
